events.summary:
The National Weather Service in Riverton has issued a Red Flag
Warning, which is in effect from noon to 8 PM MDT Monday. the Fire
Weather Watch is no longer in effect.

* AFFECTED AREA:
In Central WY Fire Zones...280...283...289...300.
In Southwest WY Fire Zone....279.

* COUNTIES AFFECTED:
In Central WY...Fremont...Natrona.
In Southwest WY...Sweetwater.

* IMPACTS: Low Humidities and Strong Gusty Winds could cause
erratic fire behavior.

* WIND: West 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 40 to 50 mph.

* HUMIDITY: As low as 10 to 15 percent.

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: Northern New Haven
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues to be
possible.

* WHERE...A portion of southern Connecticut, including the following
area, Northern New Haven.

* WHEN...Until 2 PM EDT this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding in poor drainage
areas, rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone
locations.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- Showers with heavy downpours may lead to flooding. Average total
rainfall amounts are forecast to range from 1 to 3 inches, with
localized amounts greater than 4 inches possible. Peak hourly
rates could exceed 1 inch per hour.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
